summary: Backend-only retest in PREVIEW of the iteration_327 fixes, using synthetic TEST_ data. No emails were sent. I extended tests/test_afs_large_doc_uploads_jan2026.py to 57 tests: 53 pass and 4 fail. The 4 failures come from 2 new defects; none of the fixes under test regressed. FIXED and verified: (1) verify_quantities, tested with crafted PDFs and no LLM. 'Qty two' and 'Qty -' give quantity null with qty_validation invalid, and quantity_ai is kept. A line with no Qty label where the AI number is not on the line gives null with missing. A line with no Qty label where the AI number stands alone on the line gives column_match and the value is kept. A printed Qty that differs from the AI gives corrected_from_source, with the printed value used. 'Qty 0' gives invalid. A line that cannot be located gives unverified. (2) match_lines: invalid and missing raise quantity_unconfirmed. unverified raises the blocking flag quantity_unverified, and the line is not auto-accepted. column_match raises no quantity flag. corrected_from_source raises quantity_corrected. (3) Real-LLM small mixed PDF: the Rower line with no Qty became null, missing, quantity_ai 1 and quantity_unconfirmed. 'Qty two' became null, invalid and quantity_unconfirmed. Qty 1, 2 and 10 were verified, qty 3 with 1 serial got serial_mismatch, and the spare part was excluded. The apply gate passed with no simulated null. (4) Real-LLM 400-line invoice: 400 lines and 800 units, all 400 verified, all serials and pages correct. (5) build_custom_quote pricing_job_id: a job with a POA/conflict and zero client flags gives 422 on save, and 422 again with a reason under 10 characters. Preview gives 200. A valid reason gives 200 and writes a crm2_afs_rate_reviews row with unresolved=3 (blocking 1 + 1 needs_review + incomplete coverage). A clean job saves with no reason. An unknown id, another org's job and a job of kind=import all give 404. (6) Regression: the 700-row CSV still matches every cell, with 725/725 verified. Renewal approve-send, mark-issued, cancel-email, dispatch no-op, job dedupe, stale-heartbeat and build-info all pass. NEW DEFECTS: (A) HIGH. The extract_document line-drop guard counts the column-header line 'Item code | Description | Qty | Serial' as a quantity line. The real 400-line run read all 400 lines correctly, yet returned coverage.complete=false with notes like 'page 1 – page 4: 84 quantity line(s) printed, 80 read' for all 5 sections. Every section was also re-read in halves, which tripled the LLM calls (5 → 15). With a fake LLM that reads every line perfectly, the result is still complete=false with 6 calls instead of 2. Any real invoice with a 'Qty' column header will always be marked incomplete. (B) MEDIUM. The column_match rule accepts any standalone number on the line. A leading row number '1' ('1  PF-RW-210 Rower 210 Serial X') with the AI's default qty 1 gives column_match, and the 1 is kept silently. A model number such as 'Rower 200' would also match if the AI returned 200. This partly reopens the silent default to 1.

critical.issue: want = every text line matching \b(qty|quantity)\b, so table header rows ('Item code | Description | Qty | Serial', one per page) are counted. In the real run 400/400 lines were read, but coverage.complete=false and parts_failed/notes reported '84 printed, 80 read' for all 5 sections. Each section was re-read in halves (5 → 15 LLM calls). Every correctly read invoice with a Qty column header is falsely flagged incomplete.

minor.issue: Any standalone 1–4 digit number on the located line counts as an 'unlabelled quantity column'. A leading row/line number (e.g. '1  PF-RW-210 ...') or a model number ('Rower 200') can therefore match the AI quantity, so an AI default of 1 is kept as column_match with no flag.

A pricing job that is still running or has failed has no 'result'. find_one with projection {result:1} returns {}, which is falsy, so the endpoint returns 404 'Pricing extraction not found'. This is safe because it blocks the save, but the message is misleading; return 409 'extraction not finished/failed' instead.

action_items: Fix the line-drop guard's expected count so it ignores header rows. Options: count only lines that match _QTY (a Qty label followed by a number), or exclude lines with no digits next to the label or lines containing 'Item code'/'Description'. Then confirm that a perfect read gives complete=true with no half re-reads (TestLineDropGuard::test_perfect_read_is_complete / test_transient_drop_recovered_by_halves).

Tighten column_match: ignore a leading row-number token, and ignore numbers that are part of the model/description (e.g. digits that also appear in the AI's model or item_code), or require a real column position. Or treat a match against an AI quantity of 1 as 'missing'. Tests: test_row_number_not_taken_as_quantity and test_code_digits_not_column_match.
Optional: build_custom_quote should return 409 with a clear message when pricing_job_id refers to a job that is running or failed, instead of 404.
critical_code_review_comments: extract_document: the retry merges a[1] header fields with both halves but only replaces results[i] if retry lines >= got. Correct, but with the header-row bug the retry always runs. Also, the second half loses the header context, which is fine for lines.
verify_quantities: 'Qty 0' sets invalid but does not record quantity_ai (unlike the other invalid branch). This is minor, for audit consistency.

build_custom_quote: the server-side count is max(client, server), which is correct. The frontend sends pricing_job_id after the upload. pricingJobId is not cleared when the coordinator switches to manual rate entry, so a later manual quote may still be gated by the old job. Check this is intended.
routes/crm_aftersales.py is about 4565 lines and AftersalesApp.js about 3761 lines, well over the 700-line guideline.

success_rate.backend: 93% (53/57); all 4 failures map to 2 new defects in the guard/column_match logic

seed_data_creation: Only per-run TEST_lg_<hex> records: files, jobs, imports, companies, orgs, sites, contracts, pricing jobs and rate reviews. All were deleted by id in module teardown, and the post-run check shows 0 leftovers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the no-LLM checks with: pytest tests/test_afs_large_doc_uploads_jan2026.py -k 'VerifyQuantitiesUnit or MatchLinesFlags or LineDropGuard or PricingJobGate' (about 12s). TestLineDropGuard monkeypatches emergentintegrations LlmChat with _FakeChat (modes perfect/drop/drop_first), so it costs nothing. The full file takes about 2.5 minutes with the real LLM (400-line invoice, mixed PDF, CSV, xlsx). Get tokens through utils.auth.create_token plus /api/crm/auth/cross-login for cm-test-coord, cm-test-admin and cm-test-asm. The 400-line test now xfails if lines are dropped, but only if complete=false is reported with the shortfall note.
rca of the issue: Guard false positive: utils/cm_quote_import.py line 92 counts lines with expected_re = \b(qty|quantity)\b. The fixture, like most real invoices, prints a column header 'Item code | Description | Qty | Serial' on every page, so each 4-page section expects 84 lines against 80 real ones. got (80) < want (84) triggers the half re-read, the re-read still gets 80, a 'short' note is added, and complete=false. Reproduced deterministically with the fake LLM, and on the real LLM run (400/400 read, complete=false).
